title: Tonal Display Black, No Power
shortDescription: Wall-mounted Tonal screen does not turn on.
fullDescription: The Tonal trainer requires a 110V dedicated outlet behind the wall mount. A blank screen usually means the GFCI on the wall outlet has tripped, the power cable behind the unit unseated, or a firmware crash needing a forced reboot.

fixSteps.title: Reset GFCI
fixSteps.instruction: Press the reset button on the wall outlet behind Tonal.

fixSteps.title: Force reboot
fixSteps.instruction: Hold the power button on the rear of the screen for 15 seconds.

whenToCallPro: Tonal sends a tech if reboot and GFCI reset don't restore power — main board may be failed.

faq.a: Yes — Tonal install spec requires a dedicated 20A GFCI outlet.

title: Tonal Adjustable Arms Will Not Move
shortDescription: Arms locked in position, won't slide up or down.
fullDescription: The arm release levers are mechanical. If the arms feel stuck, the most common cause is a foreign object in the rail or that the arms are loaded with cable tension that needs slack before unlocking.

fixSteps.title: Release tension
fixSteps.instruction: Return both handles to the arm clip and remove all weight from the cables.

fixSteps.title: Clean rail
fixSteps.instruction: Wipe the arm track with damp cloth and remove any debris.

whenToCallPro: If lever still won't release, request a Tonal service visit — release mechanism may need replacement.

faq.a: No — Tonal recommends only a dry wipe.

title: Tonal Cable Provides No Resistance
shortDescription: Cable pulls freely with no electromagnetic load.
fullDescription: Tonal's digital weight is generated by electromagnetic motors. If a cable provides no resistance, the motor controller has likely faulted out for safety, requiring a power cycle. A persistent issue indicates motor or driver board failure.

fixSteps.title: Power cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Trip the GFCI for 60 seconds, then restore power.

fixSteps.title: Recalibrate
fixSteps.instruction: Run the auto-calibration from Settings > Maintenance.

whenToCallPro: Tonal will replace the motor under warranty if recalibration fails.

faq.q: Will I lose my workout history?
faq.a: No — history is in the cloud.

title: Tonal Cannot Connect to Wi-Fi
shortDescription: Tonal shows offline; cannot start streamed classes.
fullDescription: Tonal needs a 5GHz or 2.4GHz network. Distance from the router, MAC address restrictions, or DNS issues commonly cause the trainer to drop offline. Tonal cannot run guided workouts offline.

causes.cause: Router signal weak at install location

fixSteps.title: Re-enter password
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > Network > Forget current Wi-Fi, reconnect with new password.

fixSteps.title: Add mesh node
fixSteps.instruction: If signal is weak, add a mesh access point near Tonal.

title: Tonal Cable Showing Wear or Fraying
shortDescription: Visible fray, kinks, or damage on Tonal pull cable.
fullDescription: Tonal cables are rated for tens of thousands of cycles but should be inspected periodically. A frayed cable must not be used — under spotter mode, a cable break is dangerous.

fixSteps.title: Request service
fixSteps.instruction: Contact Tonal support — cable replacement is a service visit covered under warranty.

whenToCallPro: Always — cable replacement is not user serviceable.

faq.q: How often should I inspect cables?

title: Tonal Spotter Mode Drops Weight Prematurely
shortDescription: Spotter detects fatigue before user actually fails the rep.
fullDescription: Spotter Mode senses bar slowdown and drops weight to prevent injury. If it triggers too early, the calibration may be off or the user moved out of the camera frame mid-set.

fixSteps.title: Adjust spotter
fixSteps.instruction: Lower spotter sensitivity in workout settings.

fixSteps.title: Stay in frame
fixSteps.instruction: Keep body in camera view throughout the set.

faq.a: Yes — turn off in workout options before starting.

title: Tonal Workout History Missing in App
shortDescription: Workouts done on the trainer don't show up in the iOS/Android app.
fullDescription: Tonal app shows synced cloud history. Sync requires the trainer to be online and logged into the same email used in the app. Family profiles must be selected before each session.

fixSteps.title: Confirm email
fixSteps.instruction: Check that app login matches Tonal sign-in email.

fixSteps.title: Network check
fixSteps.instruction: Verify trainer is online and try a manual app refresh.

whenToCallPro: Contact Tonal support for cross-account merging.

faq.q: Can two people share a Tonal?
faq.a: Yes — up to 6 family member profiles.

title: Tonal Form Detection Camera Not Detecting User
shortDescription: Smart View / form coaching does not see user in frame.
fullDescription: Tonal 2 includes a depth camera for form feedback. Insufficient lighting, obstruction in front of the unit, or a software glitch can disable form detection.

fixSteps.title: Wipe lens
fixSteps.instruction: Use a microfiber cloth on the camera lens above the screen.

whenToCallPro: If reboot and lighting don't help, the depth camera may need service replacement.

faq.q: Can I use Tonal 2 without the camera?

title: Tonal Wall Mount Movement During Use
shortDescription: Trainer rocks or shifts when pulling cables.
fullDescription: Tonal must be lag-bolted into wall studs. Movement during heavy pulls indicates the install bracket has loosened or was not anchored to studs. Stop use until secured.

fixSteps.title: Service visit
fixSteps.instruction: Request Tonal install team to re-anchor the bracket.

faq.a: Tonal sells a relocation service — DIY is discouraged.

title: Tonal Shuts Down Citing High Temperature
shortDescription: Heavy session ends with overheat warning.
fullDescription: Tonal motors generate heat under continuous heavy load. Hot, poorly ventilated rooms or a blocked rear vent can trigger thermal protection during long high-intensity sessions.

fixSteps.title: Check ventilation
fixSteps.instruction: Ensure 4 inches of clearance behind/around the unit.

fixSteps.title: Cool room
fixSteps.instruction: Lower room temp below 80F before resuming.

whenToCallPro: Call support if overheat triggers in normal conditions — fan replacement may be needed.

faq.q: Does Tonal need its own room?
faq.a: No, but adequate airflow is required.
